data.text: I’m with Emma: I’ll catch 10 tons this month. Luke, it’s generous to offer your share, but you shouldn’t have to go without to join us. Five equal shares leave enough fish to bring the lake back to 100 tons, protecting everyone’s income next month too. Let’s check our catches together each month, and if the stock drops below 100, agree on smaller limits before heading out. John, can we count on you for 10 tons?
